title: Building a Threshold Simulation for Visual Inspection

cues.en: Welcome.
cues.zh: 歡迎。

cues.en: This is the section where we look at how we build the Streamlit fraud detection dashboard.
cues.zh: 這一節要看看如何建立 Streamlit 詐欺偵測儀表板。

cues.en: So as a reminder, we've got a threshold here that has a default setting of 50% for our baseline classifier.
cues.zh: 先提醒一下，這裡有一個門檻控制項，基準分類器的預設值是 50%。

cues.en: And the intention of the dashboard is for us to simulate different thresholds and to see what the impact
cues.zh: 儀表板的目的是模擬不同門檻，並觀察這些門檻

cues.en: of different thresholds are on the model from a cost perspective as well as from a classification performance perspective.
cues.zh: 對模型成本與分類效能的影響。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is I'm going to change this threshold to something like 80%, where basically
cues.zh: 接下來，我會把門檻改成例如 80%，也就是

cues.en: any probability of being above 80% gets classified as fraud, while any class probability of being fraudulent
cues.zh: 詐欺機率高於 80% 的交易，會歸為詐欺；

cues.en: below 80% gets classified as non fraudulent.
cues.zh: 詐欺類別機率低於 80% 的，則歸為非詐欺。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: Then we also have access to a cost calculator where we can input costs for the different classifications
cues.zh: 另外，還有成本計算器，可以輸入各種分類結果的成本，

cues.en: with the purposes of creating a total cost of fraud, both for the default classifier as well as for the updated classifier whose threshold we set with this toggle.
cues.zh: 用來計算預設分類器，以及透過這個滑桿調整門檻後的更新分類器，各自的詐欺總成本。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: I'm just going to input some scores for false positives.
cues.zh: 我先為偽陽性輸入一些成本，

cues.en: Repositories, etcetera.
cues.zh: 還有真陽性等其他分類。

cues.en: And what's nice with streamlit, you can just insert the number.
cues.zh: Streamlit 很方便，可以直接輸入數字。

cues.en: You know, you can use the plus and minus to add or subtract values and just enter on the widget afterwards and it'll recalculate your total scores.
cues.zh: 也能使用加號、減號調整數值，輸入後按 Enter，系統就會重新計算總成本。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: Then further down at the bottom, what I've got is the data frame that contains all of the scores as well as all of the classifications, etcetera, for both models.
cues.zh: 再往下，底部有一個 DataFrame，包含兩個模型的全部分數、分類結果等資訊。

cues.en: So we can see here that the.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，

cues.en: New updated model has a threshold of 80 where the baseline has a threshold of 50, and we can also see the classification performance metrics.
cues.zh: 更新模型的門檻是 80，而基準模型的門檻是 50，也能看到各項分類效能指標。

cues.en: The AUC score.
cues.zh: 例如 AUC 分數。

cues.en: We can also hardcode a cut off score if that's what we want to see.
cues.zh: 如果從營運角度想查看某個固定切分值，也可以直接指定。

cues.en: From an operational perspective, we've got the average precision score, which is the area under the
cues.zh: 另外有 average precision 分數，也就是

cues.en: precision recall curve and then not using, I guess, more technical jargon.
cues.zh: 精確率－召回率曲線下面積。這裡盡量不使用太多技術術語。

cues.en: So we're not calling these false positives, true positives, etcetera.
cues.zh: 所以不會直接稱為偽陽性、真陽性等等。

cues.en: Rather, we are explaining what it actually is from a business perspective.
cues.zh: 而是用商業角度，說明它實際代表什麼。

cues.en: So the number of fraudulent transactions detected, etcetera, for your true positives and so on, as
cues.zh: 例如真陽性就寫成「偵測到的詐欺交易數」，

cues.en: well as the total number of transactions that were assessed, which is basically the total size of our testing set.
cues.zh: 另外還有已評估的總交易數，也就是整個測試集的大小。

cues.en: Then if we compare the two models, we can see that the default cost is 29,100.
cues.zh: 比較這兩個模型，可以看到預設模型的成本是 29,100。

cues.en: And then if we dial up the threshold on the updated model to 80%, then we see the total cost of fraud does increase slightly.
cues.zh: 如果把更新模型的門檻提高到 80%，詐欺總成本就會稍微增加。

cues.en: So that would be a less optimal solution.
cues.zh: 因此，這是相對不理想的方案。

cues.en: So I guess based on this, we would select the default classification thresholds.
cues.zh: 根據這個結果，我們會選用預設分類門檻。

cues.en: But that wouldn't be the case for all models.
cues.zh: 但並非每個模型都一樣。

cues.en: In certain scenarios, this would be useful.
cues.zh: 在某些情境下，這種做法會很有幫助。

cues.en: And it also allows you to impute different costs to simulate different scenarios from a business perspective, which can obviously help with planning and other things.
cues.zh: 它也讓你輸入不同成本，從商業角度模擬各種情境，協助規劃與其他決策。

cues.en: Then if we want to see how to implement this within Streamlit.
cues.zh: 接下來看看，如何用 Streamlit 實作。

cues.en: I've provided two scripts where effectively I've got a secondary module that I've created myself, which
cues.zh: 我提供了兩份程式檔，其中有一個我自己建立的輔助模組，

cues.en: is this Python script over here, which just takes a dataframe as input and then calculates the classification scores using scikit learn.
cues.zh: 就是這份 Python 程式，接收 DataFrame 作為輸入，再利用 scikit-learn 計算分類分數。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: So things like risk score, the average precision score, it puts it all into a dataframe and then prints out the dataframe that we see at the bottom of the of the dashboard.
cues.zh: 像是風險分數、average precision 分數，都會整理到 DataFrame，最後呈現在儀表板底部。

cues.en: And then it also makes the classification decisions based on the threshold that we provide as input.
cues.zh: 它也會根據我們傳入的門檻，做出分類判斷。

cues.en: So it receives a default threshold and then also the threshold that we imputed as part of that toggle selection process.
cues.zh: 所以它會接收預設門檻，以及我們透過滑桿選擇、輸入的新門檻。

cues.en: Right then.
cues.zh: 接著，

cues.en: Streamlit.
cues.zh: Streamlit

cues.en: We also need to install locally.
cues.zh: 也需要先在本機安裝。

cues.en: So using PIP install streamlit pandas and numpy.
cues.zh: 使用 pip install streamlit，另外還需要 pandas 與 NumPy。

cues.en: We've been using that a few times throughout the course.
cues.zh: 這兩個套件在課程中已經用過幾次。

cues.en: Then this section over here, we just reading in the CSV that I've saved in a previous lesson we looked
cues.zh: 這一段則是讀入先前課程儲存的 CSV，當時我們

cues.en: at saving both the target variable as well as the score or the class probability of being in the fraudulent class.
cues.zh: 將目標變數，以及屬於詐欺類別的分數或機率，

cues.en: Save that to a CSV locally.
cues.zh: 一起存成本機 CSV。

cues.en: Just make sure that you've got access to that same CSV within the same location that your two Python scripts are in, and then you can run everything together and it should automatically upload that CSV
cues.zh: 請確保這份 CSV 與兩個 Python 程式檔放在相同位置，就能一起執行，程式應會自動載入 CSV，

cues.en: and then continue with the process.
cues.zh: 然後繼續後面的流程。

cues.en: Then this is the logic to create the slider.
cues.zh: 接著，這裡是建立滑桿的程式。

cues.en: We've also set a title for the overall dashboard, so we're calling it Fraud Detection Dashboard.
cues.zh: 我們也替整個儀表板設定了標題，叫做 Fraud Detection Dashboard。

cues.en: The slider.
cues.zh: 至於滑桿，

cues.en: This is the logic that we're using here.
cues.zh: 就是使用這段程式建立。

cues.en: We've set up a default value.
cues.zh: 我們設定了預設值，

cues.en: We've got the min and the max as well as the different steps, so the increments that you can select.
cues.zh: 以及最小值、最大值和每次調整的步幅，也就是可選擇的增量。

cues.en: Then this is the step where we actually calling this get metrics dataframe function, which is the secondary one I spoke about.
cues.zh: 這一步則會呼叫剛才介紹的輔助函式 get_metrics_dataframe。

cues.en: It supplies the threshold that we set from the slider as inputs as well as the data frame which we've loaded from our local directory.
cues.zh: 把滑桿選擇的門檻，以及從本機目錄讀取的 DataFrame，作為輸入。

cues.en: And then it returns some basically what we use to populate the data frames later.
cues.zh: 它會傳回之後用來填入各個 DataFrame 的資料。

cues.en: Then the section of ear is our input box for costs.
cues.zh: 這一段則是輸入成本的欄位。

cues.en: And then what we do is we display the total cost of fraud based on those costs.
cues.zh: 接著依照這些成本，顯示詐欺總成本。

cues.en: Then we split things into two tranches, one being for the default classifications and then one being for the updated classifications.
cues.zh: 然後把內容分成兩部分，一部分是預設分類，另一部分是更新後的分類。

cues.en: So the logic is largely the same.
cues.zh: 兩者的程式邏輯大致相同。

cues.en: We've just made a distinction between the two where initially we initialized some counters for the different
cues.zh: 只是分別處理這兩種情況，先為各個

cues.en: classifications, so the number of true positives, false positives, etcetera.
cues.zh: 分類結果初始化計數器，例如真陽性、偽陽性等數量。

cues.en: We've initialized those to zero.
cues.zh: 先將這些計數器全部設為 0。

cues.en: Then we iterate through all of the rows within the threshold data frame and then we just make comparisons between the target variable and the the classification decision.
cues.zh: 再遍歷門檻 DataFrame 的所有資料列，比較目標變數與分類判斷。

cues.en: And then if that condition is met, then we increase the counter effectively building up our number
cues.zh: 如果符合條件，就增加相應的計數器，逐步累計

cues.en: of classifications in the same way that we do from a confusion matrix perspective where we work out
cues.zh: 各種分類的數量，和混淆矩陣的方式一樣，計算

cues.en: what the count of elements are within each of the quadrants, then we sum those together along with
cues.zh: 各個象限裡有多少個元素，再搭配

cues.en: the inputs for the costs that we've taken from the dashboard.
cues.zh: 儀表板輸入的成本，加總計算。

cues.en: And then we've created the total cost of fraud and we write that out to the dashboard.
cues.zh: 如此就得到詐欺總成本，並顯示在儀表板上。

cues.en: So that was for the default model.
cues.zh: 這是預設模型的處理方式。

cues.en: Then for the updated model with the classification scores that are derived from the updated thresholds, we followed the same approach.
cues.zh: 至於採用新門檻產生分類結果的更新模型，則依照相同流程處理。

cues.en: Ultimately, we write the scores back to the data frame of.
cues.zh: 最後，把分數寫回 DataFrame。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: Then the last two steps, what we do is we explicitly create those data frames where we've got all of
cues.zh: 最後兩個步驟，則是明確建立這些 DataFrame，將全部

cues.en: the performance metrics as well as the number of fraudulent transactions where we explain in plain English
cues.zh: 效能指標以及詐欺交易數整理出來，並用淺顯的文字

cues.en: what each of those classifications mean.
cues.zh: 說明每種分類結果的意思。

cues.en: And then in order to run everything together, we need to put our files into a directory together.
cues.zh: 要讓所有內容一起執行，需要把檔案放在同一個目錄。

cues.en: So we've got the app.py file, we've got the eval.py file, then we've got the error df dot csv csv
cues.zh: 包括 app.py、eval.py，以及存放評估資料的 CSV

cues.en: file.
cues.zh: 檔案。

cues.en: So we just need those three together.
cues.zh: 只要把這三個檔案放在一起。

cues.en: We need streamlit to be installed on our local python instance and then we can just use our command
cues.zh: 本機 Python 環境安裝好 Streamlit 後，就能使用命令

cues.en: line to access that folder and then just run streamlit run and then app.py and then everything should run.
cues.zh: 列進入這個資料夾，執行 streamlit run app.py，整套程式就應該會啟動。

cues.en: It should open up in your browser and then you should be able to run the full demo.
cues.zh: 瀏覽器應會自動開啟，接著就能操作完整的示範程式。
